developmentEvidence.choiceRuleAddedBeforeRun: best = highest mean of the two protocols' MAP; a simpler ranker wins only if its interval against best includes 0 in both protocols (desc did not in pool).

ranker.name: desc+kw
ranker.order: The scored stream ordered by the frozen design's probability (freeze/plan.json desc|binormal+kw: cos with the description embedded with the caller's query text; binormal on the stream with the taught answers; naive-Bayes keyword evidence); ties by cos(x, d), then id. A profile with no relevant answer orders keyword matches first (newest first), then the rest by cos(x, d).
ranker.teaching: Product teaching: the reader shows the top N articles by cos(x, d) and the top N keyword matches by cos(x, d) from the pool; the person answers yes/no; ambiguous answers are skipped.

knownWeakPoints: With one relevant answer, the relevant sd sits at its floor and the keyword evidence then sets most of the order (earnings window 0.977 for desc vs 0.867 for desc+kw).
The daily top-N precision in round 10 is not a fair comparison with a keyword list, which shows only that day's matches; per-day recall was not measured.
fresh-3 served rounds 9 and 10 (adaptive reuse); the exam is the confirmation.

examVerdictRule.stream: The 133 deepmind-outlets articles. Labels: exam/labels.jsonl (15 profiles, sha256 2bba5406...) and relevance-biology/exam/labels.json (Biology, sha256 4cb90b03...). Ambiguous left out of AP.
examVerdictRule.teaching: Product teaching from the whole labelled pool (collection + fresh + fresh-2 + fresh-3), N in {5, 10}.
examVerdictRule.profiles: Every profile with >= 3 strict relevant exam articles.
examVerdictRule.metric: AP per profile over the exam stream, mean over N; macro MAP over those profiles. Baselines: keywordNarrow and keywordBroad (matches first, newest first inside groups, ties by id) and newest.
examVerdictRule.bootstrap: Paired article bootstrap, 2000 replicates, numpy.random.default_rng(31963), stratified into two strata (articles strictly relevant to at least one verdict profile, and all others), one weight per exam article shared by every profile, N and list; percentile 95% interval of the MAP difference.
examVerdictRule.pass: Lower bound of (desc+kw - keywordNarrow) > -0.05, and the intervals against keywordBroad and newest lie entirely above 0. Otherwise fail.
examVerdictRule.once: Scored one time, through the package's ranking API and eval, after the package reproduces round 10's order for a named unit. Afterwards the exam becomes a regression set.
